# Contributing

## Documentation rules

Keep lab notes focused on:

1. learning objectives;
2. architecture;
3. Docker setup;
4. official lab workflow;
5. observations;
6. defensive lessons.

Do not add instructions intended for attacking systems outside the official isolated lab environment.

## Lab documentation template

```text
# Lab Name

## Objective

## Architecture

## Prerequisites

## Docker Setup

## Container Topology

## Official Learning Tasks

## Observations

## Countermeasures

## Docker Commands Used

## Troubleshooting

## Lessons Learned

## References
```
